q&a

What technologies do you work with? +
I have experience building applications across the full technology stack, including modern frontend frameworks, backend services, RESTful APIs, cloud platforms, databases, embedded systems, and DevOps tools. I continuously learn and adopt technologies that best fit the project's requirements.
What types of projects do you specialize in? +
I specialize in web applications, enterprise software, embedded systems, system integrations, automation solutions, and custom software designed to solve complex business and technical challenges.
Can you help with technical consulting? +
Absolutely. I work with businesses and teams to evaluate technical requirements, recommend solution architectures, improve existing systems, and provide guidance throughout the software development lifecycle.
What is your development process? +
Every project begins with understanding the requirements and business goals. From there, I design the solution, develop and test the implementation, gather feedback, and iterate to ensure the final product is reliable, maintainable, and aligned with project objectives.
Do you work with existing systems? +
Yes. Whether it's modernizing legacy applications, integrating third-party services, optimizing performance, or adding new features, I can work within existing technology stacks while minimizing disruption.
Are you available for freelance or contract work? +
Yes. I'm available for freelance projects, contract engagements, technical consulting, and long-term collaborations depending on project scope and availability.
